UPDATE csv_mapping
         SET name = ?2, delimiter = ?3, encoding = ?4, date_format = ?5, decimal_separator = ?6,
             column_date = ?7, column_label = ?8, column_amount = ?9, column_debit = ?10,
             column_credit = ?11, skip_lines = ?12, column_fee = ?13, column_state = ?14,
             state_keep = ?15
         WHERE id = ?1
